findings.claim: 10-K 明列：矽 IP 業務與潛在客戶的 in-house 設計團隊競爭；介面晶片市場競爭者含 Monolithic Power、Montage、Renesas、TI（既有競爭揭露，非新導入第二供應商事件）
findings.excerpt: In the memory interface chip market, we compete with international semiconductor companies, including but not limited to Monolithic Power Systems, Montage Technology, Renesas and Texas Instruments. In the Silicon IP market, Rambus competes with the in-house design teams at our potential customers, as well as with third-party IP suppliers, such as Cadence and Synopsys.

findings.claim: 2026 年搜尋未查得最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製 RMBS 產品環節的來源；10-Q 摘要稱記憶體介面晶片賣給 Micron、Samsung、SK hynix 及系統廠/雲端業者（客戶集中度屬背景事實）
findings.excerpt: Our memory interface chips are sold to major DRAM manufacturers, Micron, Samsung and SK hynix, as well as directly to system manufacturers and cloud providers, for integration into server and client memory modules.

note: 兩次搜尋均未發現最大客戶導入第二供應商或 in-house 化的具體事件；第二條 as_of 為估計的 10-Q 申報日。
